seed: The five the app comes with, on the shelf of a document that has taken none of them: Button, Text Field, Card, Nav Bar and Badge, with nothing typed in the search box. This is the walk that OWNS them. On 2026-09-17 a walk written about where words sit in a box was the only thing that noticed the Nav Bar tile could not be reached, and the audit that hit it concluded the app had lost the component; a starter going missing has to break the walk written for starters instead. Then it takes the last of the five off the shelf, which is the one furthest down it.

steps.note: THE TEST: all five tiles are on the Components shelf of a fresh document, with nothing typed. Every one of them is built and answers to its name, which is what a person means by finding one.
the Nav Bar came off the shelf and is in the picture as the original. It is the last of the five, so it is the one that ends up below the shelf's fold once the dock fills up.

WHAT THIS SHOWS: a SECOND starter fetched after the first one was placed. By now the selection has opened the Component, Appearance, Effects, Motion and Layout sections, which pushes the Library off the bottom of the dock and squeezes the shelf to one row, so the Card is under the shelf's own fold. The shelf scrolls to it, the way a person scrolls to it.
